portals.name: Indiana General Assembly (iga.in.gov) bill API and PDFs
portals.how: The bill pages are script-only. Call /api/getBillDetails?session_lpid=session_<year>&bill_basename=<SB0010> (endpoint found in the site JS bundle) with curl --compressed and a browser user agent; it lists versions and roll calls. Roll-call and bill PDFs are under https://iga.in.gov/pdf-documents/<GA>/<year>/<chamber>/bills/<BILL>/ (e.g. rollcalls/SB0010.340_H.pdf). /api/<year>/bills/... returns the app shell, not JSON.
